title: Water entering homes near bridge
description: Heavy rain caused river overflow. Water level is 4 feet inside houses near Ramakrishnapuram bridge. 12 people trapped on upper floors.

title: Bridge submerged and road cut off
description: Village access bridge completely submerged under fast current. 25 residents cut off from medical center. Immediate evacuation requested.

title: Residential colony waterlogged
description: Over 50 houses in Velachery inundated after storm drainage choked. Water at waist level. Elderly citizens need transport to relief camp.

title: Budameru diversion breach
description: Stream breached right embankment near Singh Nagar. Swift floodwaters gushing into ground floor apartments. Over 100 families affected.
requested_help: heavy rescue boats, drone food drops

title: Severe waterlogging on highway
description: National highway junction blocked by 3 feet stagnant water. Vehicles stalled, traffic paralyzed for 6 km. No injuries reported.

title: Brahmaputra embankment leak
description: Seepage observed on village earthen dyke near river bank. Soil eroding rapidly. Over 40 villagers attempting emergency sandbag reinforcement.

title: Commercial complex transformer fire
description: Electrical transformer burst into flames following short circuit. Thick black smoke engulfing second floor. 8 office staff trapped inside.

title: Cyclone high wind damage
description: Gusts of 110 kmph uprooted massive trees and tore tin roofs off school shelter. Power lines down across road.
requested_help: tree clearing squads, emergency power team

title: Earthquake tremors and wall collapse
description: Magnitude 5.2 shock felt. Two old masonry walls collapsed near bazaar. 3 persons sustained minor fractures.
requested_help: first aid kits, structural safety inspection
